pairs.subject: deterministic-prefix-caching
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/scan/route.ts:183 The only cache in this context stores the whole finished ScanReport for one commit (owner/repo@sha::mode), served on a re-request. There is no per-sample transform chain re-applied over training epochs, no deterministic head followed by a random augmentation tail, and no seam to find, so the subject's precondition does not hold. Searching src/app and src/components for randomizable, augmentation, dataloader and num_workers found nothing; the only 'cacheable prefix' hits are about LLM prompt caching, in src/lib/scoring and src/lib/llm, outside this context.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/scan/stream/route.test.ts:123 The key covers the commit and the engine mode, and src/lib/scan-cache.ts also checks the rubric, provider and model. That is result caching, not keying the output of a transform head, so the technique's precondition is missing.
src/app/api/scan/stream/route.ts:250 The whole scan result is delivered as one cached value. No ordered chain of stages is walked to find a split between cached and live stages.
src/app/api/scan/stream/route.ts:233 Concurrent misses are merged in memory (coalesceScan) and stored in the DB or in memory. There is no disk-file cache written by loader workers.
